commands:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
export HOME=/work/build/home LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 TZ=UTC
export QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen QT_QUICK_BACKEND=software QT_FORCE_STDERR_LOGGING=1
export QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME= QT_STYLE_OVERRIDE= XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/work/runtime
trap 'status=$?; if [ "$status" -ne 0 ] && [ -d /work/source ]; then cp -a /work/source /output/workspace; fi; exit "$status"' 0
/bin/sh /input/scripts/ci/lane.sh static-checks
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/work/source/build/deps/prefix/lib
filter='PackagedProcessTest|PackagedDbusTest|holonight_packages_checks.UpdateCheckServiceTest'
ctest --test-dir /work/source/build/test -R "$filter" --show-only=json-v1 > /output/focused-tests.json
dbus-run-session -- ctest --test-dir /work/source/build/test -R "$filter" --output-on-failure --no-tests=error
cat /work/source/build/test/Testing/Temporary/LastTest.log
cp -a /work/source/build/test/Testing /output/FocusedTesting
warnings: Qt QmlPrivate version-coupling notices retained with exact public/private Qt 6.11.2.
Optional WrapVulkanHeaders absence retained; offscreen software acceptance passes.
Expected failures in negative launcher/package fixtures are retained; enclosing suites pass.
No compiler or QML metadata warnings in accepted build/release/static logs; no runtime QML diagnostics or skips.
corrections: Initial private-Qt negative fixture allowed system fallback; isolated fixture passes.
Canonical strict tidy exposed protected state in 14 fixtures; state made public without removing assertions.
Three access sections formatted; four helpers in three fixture files made const, query results marked nodiscard, and their 25 cases rerun.
Five Q_ENUM backing types now use equivalent quint8; generated metadata resolves all five.
limitations: No native desktop/session review, package transactions, host deployment/restart, Debian qualification, publication or pinning.

Final static/focused run uses the unchanged qualified image, provider manifest and offline/caller-UID contract. Full runtime/release remains valid; only fixture const/nodiscard declarations changed afterward, verified by focused recompilation/tests.

documentation_checks.note: Only SDD/evidence metadata changes after acceptance; all files retain the same aggregate REUSE annotation.
